existing_candidates.authorTexture: Existing dispatch/profile/pin owner will gain contacts policy and route; retaining page orchestration here would enlarge unrelated TXD+comparison business paths.
existing_candidates.manifestTextures: Already owns streaming CMB extraction; contacts consumes one or more existing ZIP manifests, not another CMB parse. Adding dual ZIP/CMB source modes/font rendering to this loop would mix independent lifecycle/format decisions. Manifest format/publication remains shared.
existing_candidates.composeCells: Native cell compositor erases/fits/strokes atlas glyphs and refuses outside-cell ink; inventory labels use hinted whole TTF masks and original whole-page clipping. A new fontmode in native BitmapFont would force unrelated semantics.
existing_candidates.resizeRaster_pixelOver: Existing shared sampling/blending owners retained; no replacement numerical helper.
existing_candidates.readInput_checkJSON_writeNewFile: Reuse existing readers/schema/exclusive publisher. After Serena inspected all callers, raise readInput internal allowed ceiling64→128MiB for bounded manifestZIP reader; existing callers still pass same explicit limits and their own rolebounds. Recheck with exact retained byte size, not size+1. Sources array objects require JSON key policy depth4 (arrays count), font object depth3.
existing_candidates.RegistryInput: Existing generic artifact pin shape reused for fonts/additional manifest sources; no new duplicate pin struct.
existing_candidates.tests: Extend TestCLIDryRunAndApply and TestPilotHistoricalGoldenBytes, including disabled-font build; no new testfunction/closure.
existing_candidates.resizeRaster: Enhance existing resampler with thumbnail-nearest/thumbnail-lanczos: same bounded numerical owner computes no-upscale aspect-preserving size with original floor/ceil ratio-error tie rule, then existing sampler. Contacts chooses minaxis<=16 policy from layout table. No new sizing helper; no Gray reducing-gap claim.

unavoidable_functions.textMasks: Previously reviewed cohesive whole-label nativefont owner now consumed by contacts. One direct-CGo Go function, no Chelper.
unavoidable_functions.textMasks_disabled: Same logical interface under complementary build tags, one refusal statement. Necessary to keep all existing tools buildable without native libraries and preserve clear contacts refusal; cannot call C APIs or enhance a CGo-only function in a non-CGo build. Counts as a second source declaration, not a second backend.
unavoidable_functions.contactSheets: One shared pinned-manifest collection/group/page/inventory lifecycle. No perarchive/group/patch handler. Existing CMB extractor/nativecell renderer cannot reasonably own this source format/business duty.

native_build.default: Standard-library build retains all existing tools; contacts refuses with actionable error when font backend disabled.
native_build.enabled: nativefonts && cgo && linux; links installed FT/pkg-config +libraqm.so.0. Separate native API header pinned to installed0.10.1 release, retain MIT notice.

header.adaptation: Remove generated version-header include only; source declarations unchanged, no fabricated version macros.

native_build.cost: Count all Go+stub+header+embedded layout+examples/fontbytes/notices/config and native external dependencies; no net reduction claim.

format: Existing --texture-profile operation contacts; source pinned primary manifestZIP; contacts.sources optional pinned additional manifestZIPs in declared order; contacts.font pinned exactDejaVuTTF. Every input row retained. Common grouping/dedup then stable archive/index sort across collection. Source/profile/font bytes rechecked before one exclusive outputZIP.
layout: One embedded purpose-grouped JSON layout table, not one handler perpatch. Preserve original6x4/240x170/labels/thumb choices by data.
scope: No ISOs/canonical/protected runtime/historical mains; only new owned outputs/frozen fixtures. .06 remains uncredited until all contacts+flat90+assessment verified.
